items.text: Creation, follow-up, approval, questions, interrupt, queue, attachments, models, workspace, device management, audit and session history preserve their typed results and error mappings through the same dispatcher.

Supported protocol versions and capability combinations preserve field numbers, feature strings, close codes, replay order and cancellation behavior. The Swift client can perform Hello, resume and list against the bridge at 61b5416.

Actual dependencies and the two platform signature reports show that typed callers can use these operations without importing generated messages or naming raw HostConnection. No remaining command creates a separate receive loop.
